environment.description: Same Spring Boot service deployed on EKS in namespace 'monitoring-prod'. Calico CNI with GlobalNetworkPolicy applied at cluster level. Namespace-scoped NetworkPolicy object 'restrict-metadata-cidr' with spec.podSelector matching all pods (matchLabels: {}), spec.policyTypes ['Egress'], spec.egress containing a single rule that allows DNS (UDP/53 to kube-dns) and TCP to 10.0.0.0/8 and 172.16.0.0/12 only. The link-local CIDR 169.254.0.0/16 is NOT included in any egress allow rule, meaning traffic to 169.254.169.254 is implicitly denied by the default-deny-egress posture. Additionally, a second NetworkPolicy 'allow-internal-only' permits egress to port 443 for 10.0.0.0/8 destinations. The combination of these two policies with Calico's 'deny-by-default on policy presence' behavior means the IMDS endpoint is unreachable from any pod in the namespace.
